Auctus lost 725,680.730375 USDC, about $726,000, on Ethereum mainnet on 2022-03-26 after an old beta contract allowed a caller to route arbitrary external calls that relayed transferFrom from previously approved wallets. The Auctus beta writer flow accepted caller-controlled external-call parameters. That let an attacker turn the write path into a USDC transferFrom relay against wallets that had already approved the contract. The exact historical source revision of that beta contract was not recovered.
